t: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–331, $40,000,000 are rescinded.

fable.w: The section only rescinds $40,000,000 of previously appropriated funds. There is no tempting reading here: it involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision.

qwen_block.w: This section is a simple rescission of appropriated funds. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government. There are no advisory boards, public hearings, or requirements for outside input mentioned.
